Docs / Overview

A guide to Capital

Company discovery, transparent fee records and VCXx wallet holdings.

Explore the fund

The Businesses page highlights selected companies from Fundrise Innovation Fund’s disclosed portfolio. VCXx provides exposure to the listed fund through a tracker certificate. The company cards do not mean Capital or its holders own those companies directly.

Follow the fees

Capital’s intended funding source is Pons creator fees. A permitted VCXx purchase must be confirmed before it appears as a treasury holding. Neither a vote nor a purchase plan counts as an acquired asset.

Read your portfolio

My portfolio separates Capital’s treasury, your claim allocation and tokens actually in your connected wallet. The Ethereum balance check is read-only. Production allocations and claims are not connected yet.

Use Forum to discuss treasury ideas, Treasury proposals to review policy options, and Holder voting to sign an advisory ballot. Earlier Republic and Wefunder research remains separate. The test portfolio uses mUSD, which has no cash value.

Docs / Ownership

Understand what you hold

VCXx is tokenized fund exposure, not individual startup shares.

The ownership layers

  1. You hold VCXx, a tracker certificate issued by Backed Assets (JE) Limited.
  2. The certificate is linked to Fundrise Innovation Fund shares, ticker VCX.
  3. The fund holds its own portfolio, including exposures through other investment vehicles.

VCXx does not give its holder company shares or shareholder voting rights. Fund weights describe a dated share of fund net assets; they are not the percentage of a company you own.

Capital tokens are separate

Holding Capital’s launch token does not automatically give you VCXx, a share of the treasury or company equity. Any distribution needs its own eligibility rules, allocation and confirmed transfer.

Price and access

VCX can trade at a premium or discount to net asset value. Buying VCXx does not selectively fund one startup or let Capital change the fund’s investments. Product, venue and local distribution requirements apply; a permissionless token transfer does not establish KYC-free access.

VCXx product terms ↗ · Issuer legal overview ↗

Docs / Treasury

Where the fees go

Received fees, confirmed purchases and funded distributions each need their own record.

1. Fee receipts

Record payments actually received at Capital’s designated wallet, with the asset, network, quantity and transaction. Pons protocol-wide analytics are not Capital’s revenue.

2. VCXx purchases

Record permitted purchases with their token contract, network, amount, cost and receiving wallet. Cash conversion, fees and any bridge movement need separate records. Robinhood Chain launch assets and Ethereum VCXx are on different networks.

3. Distribution funding

Once a permitted allocation is published, transfer the required VCXx to the reviewed distribution contract. Subtract funded tokens from treasury availability so they cannot be allocated twice.

What is connected today?

No production fee source, purchase wallet or VCXx claim contract is connected. The treasury uses empty records until these can be verified. Testnet tools remain separate.

Docs / Distributions

Holdings & distributions

Docs / Wallet

Connect your wallet

Read VCXx on Ethereum without signing a transaction.

  1. Choose Connect wallet. Use MetaMask in your browser or its mobile QR option.
  2. Open My portfolio. Capital reads the official Ethereum VCXx token balance for your connected address. Your wallet does not need to switch to a testnet for this read.
  3. Check the record. A verified balance includes the Ethereum block and an explorer link. Use Refresh balance to read it again.

If a balance is unavailable

Confirm the connected address, then refresh My portfolio. A failed network read shows an unavailable state, not zero. This view currently reads Ethereum VCXx only; tokens on Solana or other networks and wrapper tokens are not included.

Claims are a separate transaction

Production claims are not connected yet. When a permitted funded distribution is published, the claim must use a compatible wallet on the distribution network. A Capital token on Robinhood Chain and VCXx on Ethereum are separate assets.

Test treasury tools

The test portfolio and interactive example are inside their own expandable section. Select a supported test treasury to read mUSD records. The test-dollar token has no cash value. The example’s 600 mUSD and 400 mUSD claims never transfer real VCXx.

Capital never asks for a private key or seed phrase. A wallet connection by itself does not transfer funds.

Docs / Faq

FAQs & sources

Are these companies our holdings?

The primary directory shows selected company exposure reported by Fundrise Innovation Fund as of June 30, 2026. It does not mean Capital owns those companies or that a holder owns their shares. Each profile links to the company’s website and the fund disclosure.

What does VCXx give me?

VCXx is a tracker certificate linked to the fund’s listed VCX shares. It is indirect exposure, without company shareholder voting rights. A wallet holding is recorded only when the token is actually in that wallet.

Can votes choose the fund’s companies?

No. Capital’s community can discuss future purchases and distribution policies under published rules, but cannot change the fund manager’s portfolio. Existing Republic and Wefunder research rounds remain separate.

What happened to Republic and Wefunder?

Their research profiles and watchlists remain in the expandable separate-research section on Businesses. Those profiles link to original offerings and are not presented as VCX holdings.

Are purchases or claims live?

No production fee source, treasury wallet, holder allocation or reviewed VCXx claim contract is connected yet. The current balance reader is read-only. No company shares or real tokens have been distributed through this update.

Does a freely transferable token mean no identity checks?

No. Issuer, venue and local eligibility rules still apply. U.S. persons and U.S. distribution are excluded. Capital’s operation from Brazil does not alone establish permission to distribute the product.

    OWNERSHIP, EXPLAINED

    How onchain equity works.

    A token can represent real ownership when legal rights and recognized ownership records connect it to an investment.

    Capital operates from Brazil · research checked September 13, 2026. Investor eligibility and production distribution rules still need to be established.

    The VCXx route

    VCXx is a tracker certificate linked to Fundrise Innovation Fund (VCX), not separate startup shares. Capital’s plan is to purchase permitted VCXx using creator fees, publish a holder snapshot, fund a reviewed contract and let eligible holders claim on Capital.

    Company cards show disclosed fund exposure. Treasury holdings, claim allocations and personal wallet balances remain separate. No production purchases or VCXx claims are connected yet.

    Read VCXx product terms ↗

    TEST PARTICIPATION

    Units for testing payouts.

    The treasury administrator assigns nontransferable test units to up to 100 wallets. They are used only to calculate a test distribution.

    1. Current units show current participation

      Attributed test cost uses your units divided by the total assigned units. It is not a withdrawable treasury balance.

    2. Each distribution freezes an allocation

      The contract funds the total and records each wallet’s payout at the transaction’s block. Later unit changes do not change existing allocations.

    3. Claims pay the eligible wallet once

      Only the allocated wallet can claim its mUSD. Test dollars have no cash value and cannot buy real company shares.

    These units are not the Pons launch token or an equity-backed token. Actual holder rights, eligibility, and a production token-to-interest formula have not been established.

    CAPITAL / ADMINISTRATOR

    Create a treasury proposal

    Publishing fixes the policy text, choices, Capital token and snapshot rules. Every option needs reviewed terms and a document source. Voting is advisory; it does not transfer tokens. One wallet does not mean one person.

    Describe the exact action, amounts and units in each option. Reference budgets are in USD; token distributions must state their VCXx amount or allocation formula in the policy.
